Although we had to pivot our project, we were able to deliver our final milestone outputs for the time, work, and funds that were invested. Our current funds for the project, plus our own additional funds have been spent attempting to fulfill our project and covering the extra advertising and legal costs.

ms.promise:
The project will have delivered a Cardano-themed tabletop card game product that introduces and connects physical game players & retailers to Cardano. 

The project will also be sustainable through manufacturing use of FSC certified paper products, as little plastic as possible, and donations from every sale going to reforestation and ocean cleanup projects (donations made in ADA).This project's final capabilities will onboard a new target market to the Cardano ecosystem in a fun and exciting way. The project will introduce new users to the Cardano community through pop culture, information about Cardano itself, and projects building on it.

This project also leads by example, showing that physical games can be manufactured with a sustainable and positive impact in mind.

ms.report:
Milestone Outputs:
The project will have delivered a Cardano-themed tabletop card game product that introduces and connects physical game players & retailers to Cardano. 
Yes, this was delivered. Due to funding limitations and costs exceeding our initial expectations, our plans to mass produce the game were not a success. We did attempt a Kickstarter sale for the game, but despite our marketing efforts, this only had limited buyers from outside of Cardano and none from the Cardano community (even with our 2 years of advertising via Captivate FT card drops).
Although we had to pivot our project, we were able to deliver our milestone outputs for the time, work, and funds that were invested. Our current funds for the project, plus our own additional funds have been spent attempting to fulfill our project and covering the extra advertising and legal costs.

The game is available for retail sale via The Game Crafter online store (our prototype printer):
https://www.thegamecrafter.com/games/captivate:-cardano-edition
We also have a Print & Play Copy available (free for personal and non-commercial use):
https://drive.google.com/file/d/18SQDJOEjV4wK8xLzGUi0KBMsj5wyklL6/view?usp=sharing
Captivate: Cardano Edition Rulebook:
https://drive.google.com/file/d/1zjvJT88IYgCdW5MiKTB7m-t6N8eaaEVu/view?usp=sharing

The project will also be sustainable through manufacturing use of FSC certified paper products, as little plastic as possible, and donations from every sale going to reforestation and ocean cleanup projects (donations made in ADA).
